summary: Jazz Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce FDA approval of two Ziihera (zanidatamab-hrii)-containing regimens for first-line HER2+ gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma. The press release (Exhibit 99.1) details regulatory approval, not a financing or corporate event. No deal terms, pricing, or special-situation mechanics apply. The event is a product approval disclosure, a routine current report for a biopharma. No risk-arb or activist angle exists. This is not a special situation; category is None.
